method: Read-only standard-library arithmetic on all W39/W38 individual results, resolved configs, cap decisions, compact transition/value rows, per-episode records and job ledgers. No physics or neural-network recomputation.

phase_lineage.ancestor_fork_identity_rule: Preserve the W38 fork_identity unchanged as ancestry; validate W39 current stream/phase through phase_lineage, not by treating ancestor stream as current stream.

outcomes.observation_source: New saved rollouts plus final valid resume tail; no inferred missing observations.

temporal_comparison.basis: first and last equal-size halves of natural terminal episodes; middle natural episode omitted when odd; all truncations excluded

material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.

legal_route.criterion: Original base strip x[.8,2.2],abs(y)<=.6 and actual interior-foot Fz>0 at500Hz; return uses reversed boundaries. Signed credit is provisional and retracted on illegal/incomplete passage. Formal evaluator unchanged.

resolved_ppo_config.implementation: existing standard Tianshou PPO core; no algorithm/platform replacement
resolved_ppo_config.device: Resolve on authorized hardware once before training; use the same actor/critic device policy for both groups. A small PPO network need not be enlarged to occupy VRAM.

numeric_schema.transition_clock: time_s is transition end in that episode; action held over [time_s-dt_s,time_s]
numeric_schema.PANN: Causal observer recovery at 0.002/0.2/0.5 s, each foot, metres; saved normalized obs[-12:] times0.001.
numeric_schema.phase_channels: obs[80:89] in original fixed nine-phase order
numeric_schema.value: Saved behavior value/next_value; no network recomputation. bootstrap_value is zero on physical terminated, next_value on external truncated.
numeric_schema.reward_components: Original recorded increments; action_change absent in W38 logs is reported missing, not inferred from reward.
numeric_schema.behavior_version: Recorded at sampling when available, otherwise saved update boundaries (new update applies after its last sampled transition).
numeric_schema.evaluation_W38_missing: Original fixed-policy W38 evaluation saved transition scalars but no rollout values/features; unavailable fields remain null.

limitations: A and B are independent optimizer continuations from a shared W37 ancestor, not independent from-scratch replications.
Target-complete truncations and B episode272 60-second external truncation are not natural physical failures.
W38 action_change reward component is missing in all2048 exported rows; formula check is scoped to W39.
Saved PANN/value tables are available; full observation vectors and optimizer arrays are not present in Git compact evidence.
W39 selected E30 control/physical/plan windows exist in numeric-evidence; the separate code audit covers them. Training-wide accepted/restoration traces are not present in this numeric export.
A/B episode and transition IDs overlap. All joint counts combine per-stream statistics rather than joining bare numeric IDs across streams.
Diagnostics publication_pending means prepared local source manifest, not verified uploaded/read raw assets.
Observed W38/W39 differences confound controller revision, continued learning and stochastic trajectories; they are not an isolated causal repair effect.
Per-episode planning wall is RPC latency in synchronous offline simulation; logical deadline misses do not by themselves prove physical lag caused falls.
Mean/median/max are descriptive; related continuations and repeated states preclude treating every transition as an independent experimental replicate.
